description: This file contains unit tests for the Thunder project, specifically testing the enumeration type functionality within the core namespace. It defines a test enum, performs various tests on enumeration assignment, conversion, and comparison, and includes test cases for case sensitivity and text fragment parsing.

classes.name: TestEnum
classes.description: An enumeration class with values ONE, TWO, THREE used for testing enumeration functionalities.

methods.name: CheckEntries
methods.description: Tests the enumeration entries for correct value and name associations.

methods.name: Assignment
methods.description: Tests assignment of string values to the enumeration, including case sensitivity and invalid values.

methods.name: FromEnumType
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from enum type and verifying value and string representation.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from integer value and handling invalid values.

methods.name: FromStringCaseSensitiveTrue
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from string with case sensitivity enabled.

methods.name: FromStringCaseSensitiveFalse
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from string with case sensitivity disabled.

methods.name: FromTextFragmentCaseSensitiveTrue
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from text fragment with case sensitivity enabled.

methods.name: FromTextFragmentCaseSensitiveFalse
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from text fragment with case sensitivity disabled.

methods.name: FromTextFragmentCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Tests creating enumeration from text fragment with case insensitivity.
